first_pass_scientific_annotation.human_or_model: One-month-old male mdx mice; assessed at four months; in vivo breathing/inspiratory pressure and ex vivo diaphragm force

first_pass_scientific_annotation.dose_route_schedule_duration: 0.8 mg/kg methylprednisolone i.p. weekly; combination also 1% NAC in drinking water daily; three months

first_pass_scientific_annotation.hierarchy_missingness_unknowns: Primary/secondary hierarchy, sample sizes, control details and experiment-specific harms not reported. No human efficacy inference.
